artworks.title: Fedoa Americana, pectore ruso
artworks.artist: Johann Michael Seligmann after George Edwards
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bird with long legs and a red chest. The bird is standing on green grass beside a small tree trunk, with its bill pointing forward. Its feathers display a mix of brown, red, and white tones. In the background, a small house with a red roof can be seen nestled among trees. The drawing includes text in the upper portion with Latin and French notations.

artworks.title: Psittacus albus cristatus maximus
artworks.artist: Johann Sebastian Leitner after George Edwards
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: This shows a cockatoo perched on a branch. The cockatoo is detailed with red-tipped feathers on its crest, white and beige overlapping feathers on its body, a blue eye, and a black beak. The branch has bark detail and some foliage at its base. The drawing portrays the beauty of the bird and its natural setting.

artworks.title: Psittacus minor viridis cauda longiore Occidentalis
artworks.artist: Johann Sebastian Leitner after George Edwards
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: A green parakeet is perched on a bare tree branch, next to an orange and yellow butterfly. The color palette includes green for the parakeet, brown for the tree and ground, and orange and yellow for the butterfly. The parakeet's long tail extends downwards on the branch, and the butterfly is fluttering above the branch.

artworks.title: Psittacus minor gutture fusco, occidentalis
artworks.artist: Johann Sebastian Leitner after George Edwards
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: The image shows a large parrot positioned upside down on a branch. The parrot is predominantly green with a blue patch on its head and wings. Its wings and tail feathers are spread open, showcasing its detailed plumage. Two orange-red fruits with green leaves are below the branch. The color palette includes earthy browns, vibrant greens, and vivid red.

artworks.title: Psittacus viridis minor Mexicanus
artworks.artist: Johann Sebastian Leitner after George Edwards
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Dr. and Mrs. George B. Green
artworks.description: The image shows a parrot perched on a tree branch. The parrot has distinct colors: orange-yellow on its head and chest, green on its wings and back, and white with gray markings on the belly. The bird is on a branch surrounded by green leaves and a cut tree trunk. The background is blank, emphasizing the bird and plant life. The style resembles traditional ornithological illustrations.

artworks.title: George Washington on Horseback
artworks.artist: William Holl II after John Faed
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 61.5 x 46 cm (24 3/16 x 18 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a man riding a white horse. The horse is facing the right, but the man's head is turned to the left. He is holding a long, thin sword in his right hand, pointing it outward. His left hand holds the reigns of the horse, and a tricorn hat is tucked by his elbow. The man has pale skin, a long nose, deep-set eyes, and a thin mouth in a neutral expression. His white hair is styled in curls around his ears. He is dressed in what looks like a military uniform, wearing a dark jacket with epaulettes that is buttoned over a vest and a high-necked white cravat, with light-colored trousers and tall black boots. The background shows a dramatic sky filled with clouds, and the ground is covered with low rocky formations.

artworks.title: Evening
artworks.artist: Adriaen Collaert after Maarten de Vos
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a landscape scene. The image features a large, seated, nude figure on clouds in the sky with a crescent moon. Below her is a busy landscape with buildings, including a church-like structure with a clock tower, people walking towards it, small houses, a farm with livestock and people working or resting, and trees in the background. The drawing is rich in intricate lines and shading, typical of a detailed etching, capturing architectural elements and scenes of daily activity. The foreground and background seamlessly blend to create a composition of human interaction with nature and the divine.

artworks.title: The Vestal Virgin Tuccia
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Jan van der Straet
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to plate): 21.8 x 28.2 cm (8 9/16 x 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting multiple figures and structures in a mythological scene. The image shows a muscular male figure pouring water from an urn while seated on a riverbank, possibly representing a river god. In the foreground, a woman in flowing garments is using a sieve, and behind her, another figure is performing a similar action near a circular temple-like structure. A regal female figure is on the right, surrounded by several putti, another seated figure, and two unusual creatures resembling a bull and a wolf. The background includes classical buildings, trees, and figures engaging in various activities. The drawing is detailed with a strong use of chiaroscuro to enhance depth and texture, presenting an intricate composition of mythological and allegorical elements.

artworks.title: Rialto
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scenic view from a bridge over a river or canal. The scene shows various figures standing and leaning against the railing of a stone bridge, possibly overlooking a waterway. The drawing features detailed etching with fine lines and shading, capturing a bustling riverside setting with buildings along the shore and boats on the water. It is characterized by a dense application of hatching lines, providing depth and texture to the figures and architectural elements, conveying a sense of motion and urban life.

artworks.title: Paris Street Scene
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Stuart P. Feld
artworks.description: The image shows a street view in an urban setting with people and horse-drawn carriages. The horizon is high with buildings and chimneys in the background. The sketch features dynamic lines capturing movement. The color scheme is monochromatic with black ink on a white background. People walk, and carriages are depicted with detail. Trees line the street, leading to the distance. Buildings on both sides are detailed with hatching and cross-hatching for shadow and depth.

artworks.title: The Round Tower
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, and burnishing on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection, acquired with assistance from The Morris and Gwendolyn Cafritz Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts intersecting lines and geometric shapes, forming a labyrinth of staircases, arches, and structures. The composition conveys a complex architectural maze with surreal elements like staircases and arches found in ancient buildings. The various elements suggest an upward movement within a large space. Light and shadow effects create depth, while dark tones emphasize the intricate details of the scene.

artworks.title: The Lion Bas-Reliefs
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Mark J. Millard Architectural Collection, acquired with assistance from The Morris and Gwendolyn Cafritz Foundation
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a complex architectural scene. The artwork depicts a network of arches and vaults within a structure resembling ancient Roman ruins. There are heavy chains and pulleys woven through the space, alongside statue-like figures and carved reliefs integrated into the architecture. A lion is prominently depicted in the foreground. The composition is densely packed with textures and shadowed lines, emphasizing the monumental scale and intricate details. The linework and interpretation of space invoke a sense of wonder and grandeur.

artworks.title: Horseman and Attendants at the Edge of a Wood
artworks.medium: black chalk and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded landscape from a slightly elevated angle. A horizon, lined with trees and a distant mountain, is visible about one-third of the way from the top. The brushwork uses soft strokes creating a wash effect for a hazy, atmospheric appearance. The monochromatic palette of gray tones adds a tranquil feel. Silhouetted figures are seen walking on a path, with a textured landscape of trees and foliage. The scene extends to show more simplified figures under trees, rolling hills, and distant rural buildings.

artworks.title: Lovers in a Thunderstorm
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray wash and white heightening over black chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing closely together. The man has wavy shoulder-length hair and is dressed in a knee-length tunic. The woman has long, flowing hair and is wearing a full-length gown with a floral pattern around the waist. They are standing against a backdrop of dense foliage and trees. In the distance, there is a body of water with sailing ships, under a dramatic sky filled with swirling clouds and lightning.

artworks.title: Fan Design [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on green paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fan with intricate designs. The drawing includes a central figure surrounded by swirling forms. The figure sits atop a creature with a face and is flanked by two smaller, winged beings. Floral motifs, butterflies, and ladybugs are present. The composition is framed within a semi-circular fan shape, detailed in pencil on a muted paper background. The style suggests a graceful and delicate approach to the elements.

artworks.title: Fan Design [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on green paper
artworks.description: The image shows a circular scene with figures surrounded by decorative elements. In the center, there are three swirling figures enclosed within a circular boundary. Surrounding the figures are swirling lines creating movement. Below and to the sides of the central circle, there are floral and abstract motifs sketched in an arching arrangement. The sketch is on yellowed paper, and there is handwritten text visible, possibly a signature and a date reading "Kandín 1906."

artworks.title: Seated Young Woman [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper half of the body, from the head down to her waist. She is depicted in a seated position with arms softly positioned down along her sides. Her facial features include a slight profile with a serene and contemplative expression. She has shoulder-length hair with bangs across her forehead and is wearing a dress with short sleeves. The sketch is rendered in pencil with soft shading, and there are no visible accessories or objects in her hands. The background is simply shaded with pencil strokes, lending a subtle texture around her figure, and there is a signature and date in the lower right corner of the sketch.

artworks.title: The Nauwerk Family
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of seven individuals with full bodies visible. There is a standing man reading from a piece of paper on the left, a seated woman holding an infant next to him, and another seated man gesturing with a bottle. Three women stand behind them. The background is a plain, lightly shaded indoor setting.

artworks.title: Nude Woman
artworks.medium: graphite over black crayon on light green paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 29.5 x 21 cm (11 5/8 x 8 1/4 in.)
support: 40.6 x 31.7 cm (16 x 12 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a woman from the thighs up, drawn with minimal lines. She is in an upright, slightly angled position, with one arm raised and bent at the elbow, and the other arm stretching off to the right beyond the edge of the paper. Her facial features include defined eyebrows, simple eyes, a small nose, and a mouth that appears to be in a slight smile. She has short, wavy hair framing her face. The woman is nude. The background is plain beige paper, and there is a rectangular border around the drawing.

artworks.title: Oriental in a Fantastic Headdress
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a man with a turban featuring an intricate design. He has a prominent mustache and wears a robe with a high collar. The background is minimal, with simple shaded lines.

artworks.title: Two Men Resting near a Lake
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and black wash
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the image with distant mountains. The terrain includes hills and a path with two figures seated nearby. On the right, a cluster of trees is depicted. The artwork is monochromatic, likely created with graphite or charcoal.

artworks.title: Travelers in a Rocky Wood
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray and black wash
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 24.2 x 33.4 cm (9 1/2 x 13 1/8 in.)
support: 29.6 x 38.7 cm (11 5/8 x 15 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a tranquil landscape from a slightly elevated perspective. Trees obscure the horizon while a figure on horseback travels in the distance. Closer, another figure sits on the ground with a dog beside them. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes, creating a detailed scene. The color palette is primarily grey and black on a light background, highlighting the texture and shadows of the landscape. Trees are depicted with fine, detailed lines, suggesting a serene setting.

artworks.title: The Assassination of King Wenzel III
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray and light brown wash
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fallen figure lying on the ground, with a group of armed figures engaged in a confrontation in an architectural interior. The fallen figure appears lifeless, wearing robes and falling backwards. The armed figures are shown in a chaotic scene, brandishing swords and weapons. The lighting creates elongated shadows, enhancing the drama. The figures are depicted with dynamic poses, displaying action. The detailed linework and attention to light and shadow convey a moment of conflict.

artworks.title: Studies for a Boatman
artworks.medium: black and blue chalk on red-brown paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows two male figures in a classical style. The figure on the left has a beard and curly hair, with detailed facial features, holding an object in one hand and an open palm in the other. The figure on the right is less detailed, with a mustache, grasping a pole across his chest. Both figures are muscular and unclothed. The background is a plain surface with sketched hands.
